# skycloak_realm_users (Data Source)

Users in a realm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_realm_users" "all" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address.
- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the email is verified.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user can sign in.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `username` (String) Username.
